description:
Register a new website. This provisions the consent banner: it creates the site, a default banner configuration, default cookie categories, and kicks off a background cookie scan. There is no website limit per plan; billing is per website.

Args:
  - domain (string): The bare domain with no protocol and no "www" (e.g. "example.com"). It is normalized server-side.

Returns JSON: the created Site object. publicId, status, and ownership are assigned by the server and cannot be set by the caller.

Prefer consentease_setup_site for onboarding: it is idempotent and returns the snippet in one call. After creating a site with this tool, call consentease_get_embed_snippet to obtain the install snippet. An existing normalized domain for the same owner returns conflict (409), with the existing site id in the hint; no second site is created. Requires scope: sites:write.

domain.description: Bare domain, no protocol or "www" — e.g. "example.com".

name: consentease_create_site
title: Create a ConsentEase site
